catalog.eyebrow: 01 / Deftere Kaaye Marmar e Kuugal Bayeeji
catalog.intro: Ƴeewto bate tabitinaaɗe, ƴeewto no geɗe ɗen ngoodiri, nden moobtu ɗaɓɓitaande coodgu kaaye marmar keewɗe ngam neldugol gila Abuja walla export har woorooje.
catalog.requestSchedule: Ɗaɓɓitu Limto Geɗe Ɗe Ngoodi Jonia
catalog.emptyTitle: Alaa kaaye marmar hawritiiɗe e ɗaɓɓitaande ma
catalog.emptySubtitle: Mitu ko ɗaɓɓitotoɗaa walla ƴeewtu kaaye marmar Naajeeriya tabitinaaɗe ɗe 8 fuu.
catalog.footerNote: Bate kaaye marmar fuu e ɗon teenaa e jarribo laboratori heɓanɗo seedamfaagu (SGS / Intertek / Alfred H Knight) ko adii neldude.

lithium.name: Sare Lithium
lithium.subtitle: Spodumene & Lepidolite
lithium.origin: Nasarawa, Kogi & Kwara Pegmatite Belt, Naajeeriya
lithium.description: Kaaye Spodumene e Lepidolite lithium ƴettaaɗe e nokkuuje pegmatite nder caka Naajeeriya, suɓaaɗe e heblanaa e sifaaji e ɗaɓɓitaande soodoowo ngam waɗugo lithium carbonate e hydroxide.
lithium.complianceNote: Ɗon waddaa e seedamfaagu asli nokku, jarribo laboratori ko adii lelnugol, e ɗereji export dow dookaaji NEPC.
applications: Waɗugo batteri EV & feewnugol kemikal lithium
Geɗe seramik & alenaaji borosilicate dogooji hiite
Neebam gollorde e geɗe jamɗe caɗtuɗe

gold.name: Sare Kange & Alluvial Concentrates
gold.subtitle: Kaaye Kange Tabitinaaɗe e Laboratori
gold.origin: Caka e Woila-Woyla Schist Belt, Naajeeriya
gold.description: Kaaye Kange ƴettaaɗe e kaaye quartz e alluvial golliraaɗe e hakkiilo mawngo dow dookaaji kisal, e seedamfaagu jarribo yiite (fire-assay) ko adii soddiye.
gold.complianceNote: Ɗon soodaa tan e jeyal jamɗe Naajeeriya laawɗiingal, binndi kisal, e seedamfaagu fire assay ɓataŋkeewal.
terms: Moobte e Resorde e Hakkiilo Kisal
packagingOptions: Konkooji Jamɗe Uddaaɗe e Kisal Mawngal
Sendol Geɗe Jarribo ngam Fire Assay Ɓataŋkeewal
applications: Feewnugol kange e waɗugo kaalis kange laawɗuɗo
Masaanaaji feewnitooɗe kange
Laabi dokkal kange ngam resorde mawnde

tin.name: Sare Tin
tin.subtitle: Cassiterite Concentrate (SnO₂)
tin.origin: Jos Plateau & Caka-Woila Tin Belt, Naajeeriya
tin.description: Sare Cassiterite ɓuuɓnaande e ƴettaande e nokkuuje Jos Plateau nder Naajeeriya, lootaande e wittaande e baawɗe maagnetik ngam heɓugo laaɓal ngal industri duuniyaaru ɗaɓɓita.
tin.complianceNote: Ɗon waddoo e seedamfaagu XRF/wet-chemistry tin e ɗereji seedamfaagu kisal radiation so konteena ɗon haɓɓaa.
applications: Feewnugol tin & kuutorɗe eñol elektroniks ɗe ngalaa bee
Gartugol karfe nyaamdu e kemikal kisal
Waɗugo bronze e jamɗe gollorde caɗtuɗe

coltan.name: Columbite & Tantalite (Coltan)
coltan.subtitle: Sare Bate Dogooji ɗe Ta₂O₅ / Nb₂O₅ Ratio
coltan.moq: 1 × 20ft Container (20 MT) / Neldugol Bee Piirowal e Ƴeewndo
coltan.leadTime: Balɗe golle 10 – 18 haa e heɓol ɗereji
coltan.description: Sare Columbite-Tantalite feewnaande ngam waɗugo capacitors elektroniks, superalloys, e injinariŋ piirooji, yahrude e ƴeewndo radiation e bate XRF/ICP.
coltan.complianceNote: Neldugol fuu ɗon rewa e ƴeewndo radiation dookaaji e jarribo laboratori ngam huutoraade dookaaji duuniyaaru.
packagingOptions: Mba’uuji Mawɗi FIBC 1,000 kg dow Pallets
applications: Tantalum electrolytic capacitors ngam semiconductors e 5G
Nickel-niobium superalloys ngam turbines piirooji e mahdi
Feewnugol karfe structural steel teekngal

lead-zinc.name: Sare Lead & Zinc
lead-zinc.subtitle: Galena & Sphalerite Sulfide Concentrates
lead-zinc.description: Sare Galena (lead sulfide) e Sphalerite (zinc sulfide) moƴƴuɗe ƴettaaɗe e nokku Benue Trough nder Naajeeriya, sendaaɗe ngam jamɗe, karfe galvanizing, e waɗugo batteriiji industri.
lead-zinc.complianceNote: Ɗon sendee e maŋgasiin lead walla zinc ka ɗaɓɓitaa, e seedamfaagu kilo e jarribo laboratori ko adii neldude.
applications: Batteriiji lead-acid industri e huuro goɗɗum ngam kisal
Zinc galvanizing ngam reenugo karfe mahdi
Alloys die-casting, brass, e kemikal zinc oxide

iron.name: Sare Jamɗe (Iron Ore)
iron.subtitle: Hematite & Magnetite
iron.origin: Kogi & Niger Iron Ore Belt, Naajeeriya
iron.description: Hematite e Magnetite jamɗe teekɗe heblanaaɗe blast-furnace walla sinter fines, tottiraangel bate Fe tabitinaaɗe e gangue famɗuɗo ngam suuɗi jamɗe, kilns cement, e export.
iron.complianceNote: Ɗon waddaa e tikitiiji kilo bayeeji tabitinaaɗe e bate laboratori dow geɗe Fe/gangue.
applications: Feewnugol karfe, direct reduction (DRI), e rolling mills
Additive peewnorgol Portland cement
Heavy aggregate ballast e teddinoore concrete teekɗum

limestone.name: Limestone & Aggregates Marble
limestone.subtitle: Kaaye Carbonate Calcium Dogooji
limestone.origin: F.C.T. / Kogi / Edo Limestone Belt, Naajeeriya
limestone.description: Limestone laaɓɗo e kaaye marble mahdi ƴettaaɗe ngam feewnugol cement clinker, hydrated lime, flue-gas desulfurization, e dewal mahdi mawndi.
limestone.complianceNote: Sahora neldugol heblanaama ngam faktoriiji cement e kamfaaniiji mahdi nder Abuja e leydi fuu.
applications: Feewnugol cement clinker e kilns quicklime / hydrated lime
Filler industrial calcium carbonate (fainti, PVC, ɗari, ndema)
Huurooji marble mahdi, leydi, e kaaye mahdi laabi

aggregates.name: Granite Aggregates, Laterite & Lesdi Ndiru (Sharp Sand)
aggregates.subtitle: Geɗe Bayeeji & Kuugal Mahdi Laabi
aggregates.leadTime: Waktuuji 24 – 72 nder F.C.T. Abuja e saraaji mum
aggregates.description: Kaaye granite tewaaɗe, laterite teekɗum laabi, e lesdi ndiru lootaandi neldaaɗi bee motaaji Gargati haa nokkuuji injinariŋ, ponti, cuuɗi, e laabi.
aggregates.complianceNote: Engin wallitoo e motaaji Gargati ɗi ngoni e Abuja ngam dokkal yaawngal ngal meƴƴataako ngam mahooɓe.
packagingOptions: Sahora Neldugol Motaaji Keewɗe e Balɗe Ngam Mahooɓe
Looding e Bayeeji Direkt ngam Motaaji Coodoowo
applications: Waɗugo concrete teekɗum ngam mahdi (ponti, cuuɗi toowɗi, ɗaɗi)
Asphalt laabi, les sub-base laabi, e feewnugol ilooji ndiyam
Golle mahdi cuuɗi e babal gollorde nder F.C.T. Abuja

engineering.intro: Ko ɓuri ƴettugol kaaye marmar nɗirɗe, fedde amin injinariŋ nder Abuja ɗon huwo kuugal leydi mawngal, mahdi concrete teekɗum, motaaji dawaadgol bayeeji, e ƴeewndo leydi les njiimaandi gollorde wootere.
engineering.bannerTitle: Gollodal Wootal gila Asgol Bayeeji haa e Yottinorde Mahdi.
engineering.bannerBody: Bee hawtugo kaaye bayeeji amin, motaaji marsooji leydi, e injinienɓe mahdi laawɗinaaɓe, ministeer e mahooɓe mawɓe ɗon ɗoofta leeltal gollodiiɓe keewɓe e caɗele moƴƴere geɗe mahdi.

capabilities.title: Heblannde e Asgol Bayeeji Kaaye
capabilities.subtitle: Golle Leydi Bayeeji Oopen & Bayeeji Kaaye
capabilities.description: Udditgol nokku kuugal fuu, waɗugo laabi motaaji, benciiji laaɓɗi, e ƴettugol lesdi dow ngam kisal e heɓol kaaye marmar keewɗum.
deliverables: Seefngo benci bayeeji & ittol lesdi yaasi
Bate laabi dawaadgol & ilooji ndiyam toɓo
Huubaangal kisal nokku kuugal & reenugo bayeeji
capabilities.equipmentOrMethodology: 30T–45T Excavators Hydraulic · Bulldozers · Motaaji Dumps Articulated

capabilities.title: Mahdi Civil & Injinariŋ Structural
capabilities.subtitle: Mahdi Laabi, Industri & Cuuɗi Mawɗi
capabilities.description: Mahdi injinariŋ haa Naajeeriya fuu—yottinorde concrete teekɗum, ilooji ndiyam, defterduji industri, e laabi cuuɗi mawɗi.
deliverables: Ponti concrete teekɗi, culverts & kokke reenorɗe
Defte gollorde, ɗaɗi kilooji motaaji & suuɗi feewnorde
Laabi cuuɗi njulaaku e ilooji ndiyam
Mahdi concrete e asphalt meƴƴinaaɗi laboratori
capabilities.equipmentOrMethodology: Dookaaji Structural BS / NIS · Jarribo QA/QC · Hakkiilo Kuugal Fuu

capabilities.title: Geñol Motaaji Mawɗi & Dawaadgol
capabilities.subtitle: Motaaji Marsooji Leydi & Dawaadgol Kaaye Marmar
capabilities.description: Neldugol motaaji mawɗi golliraaɗi, laabi tewre yaawɗi, e motaaji dawaadgol kaaye marmar ngam jokkondirgo bayeeji e woorooje export.
deliverables: Excavators, bulldozers & wheel loaders dow kontrak
Motaaji dumps articulated & tippers 30T–45T ngam dawaadgol
Masaanaaji tewre jaw/cone & tankiiji sifting bayeeji
Laabi dawaadgol konteenaaji gila bayeeji haa woorooje export
capabilities.equipmentOrMethodology: Wallitoore Ƴeewndo Balɗe Fuu · Gollotooɓe Heblooɓe · Jarribo GPS Waybill

capabilities.title: Ƴeewndo Leydi (Geology) e Asgol Kaaye
capabilities.subtitle: Keertagol Bate Kaaye, Jarribo & Dookaaji
capabilities.description: Ƴeewndo nokku kuugal ɓataŋkeewo, asgol diamond/RC core drilling, ƴettugol jarribo kaaye, e ƴeewndo nokkuuje ɗe ustata hatere marsooɓe kaaye.

Hakkiilo e resogol ko asaa e core drilling
Bate diidaaɗe dow kaaye ngoodaaɗe & moƴƴere majje

projects.headingPart1: Dawaadgol gila Bayeeji haa Nokku Kuugal &
projects.intro: Asgol leydi heblanaangal, hakkiilo kilooji motaaji, jarribo laboratori tabitinaaɗo, e dawaadgol direkt nder laabi kaaye marmar Naajeeriya e gure mahdi mawɗe.
projects.stagingCaption: Resogol jarribo kaaye, baagol FIBC 1MT & looding konteenaaji bee lambaaji.
projects.protocolTitle: Laabi Nay ɗe Tabitingol Njiɓe e Yottinorde
projects.surveyorNotice: Ƴeewotooɓe coodoowo suɓii (SGS, Intertek, Alfred H Knight) ɗon jaɓɓee ngam heɗaade jarribo e bayeeji walla e woorooje export.

corridors.title: Laawol Dokkal Pegmatite & Iron Ore nder Caka-Woila
corridors.summary: Moobte, seefngo, e heblannde FIBC 1MT ngam lithium (spodumene/lepidolite), tin cassiterite, coltan, e 60–65% Fe iron ore ngam faktoriiji nder leydi e export Lagos/Port Harcourt.

corridors.title: Motaaji Aggregates Concrete & Road-Base F.C.T. Abuja
corridors.summary: Motaaji tippers jawɗi ɗon yottina 1/2" e 3/4" granite, conndi kaaye, lesdi ndiru lootaandi, e laterite teekɗum haa e mahooɓe laabi, faktoriiji concrete, e cuuɗi mawɗi.

corridors.title: Moobte Galena & Sphalerite nder Benue Trough
corridors.summary: Moobte jamɗe lead sulfide (PbS) e zinc sulfide (ZnS) e sendol njiɓe, ƴeewndo ndiyam, e jarribo XRF ɓataŋkeewal ko adii loowgol e konteenaaji.

corridors.title: Heblannde Nokku Kuugal, Ilooji Ndiyam & Babal Industri Hawtaangal
corridors.summary: Hawtugol marsugol leydi teekɗum, maɓɓugol les sub-base, ilooji ndiyam concrete teekɗum, e dokkal geɗe bayeeji les njiimaandi kampani gollotoodo wooto.

stages.title: Fahmitingol Sifaaji e Manngu
stages.detail: Soodooɓe ɗon nelda manngu tons yiɗaaɗo, bate lab, nokku yottinorde, e Incoterms laawol Desk Coodgu amin walla binndol injinariŋ.

stages.title: Jarribo Laboratori & Ƴeewndo Ɗereji Laamu
stages.detail: Geɗe jarribo ɗon ƴettaa ngam bate laboratori heɓanɗo seedamfaagu, ƴeewndo ndiyam, e ɗereji asli nokku ko adii fiɓnde njiɓol.

stages.title: Feewnugol, Tewre & Baagol
stages.detail: Kaaye ɗen ɗon tewaa, lootoo, walla mba’ee e mba’uuji FIBC 1MT lambaaji, buhuuhaaji PP 50kg, konkooji kisal, walla motaaji tippers.

stages.title: Dawaadgol Bayeeji haa Nokku Kuugal & Export Woorooje
stages.detail: Dawaadgol heblanaangal ɗon yottina direkt haa nokku kuugal nder Naajeeriya walla haa woorooje export nder Lagos (Apapa/Tin Can) e Port Harcourt.

about.narrativeSuffix: ɗon huwo e ɗooftagol dookaaji gollorde Naajeeriya, tabitingol dookaaji kaaye marmar, e heblannde export—hollude soodooɓe duuniyaaru, mahooɓe laabi, e ministeereeji laamu gollodiiɗo laaɓɗo.
